instruction:
A parallel-computation template `/home/user/Desktop/parallel_base.py` is provided. Run your scripts with Python in an environment where `floris` is installed (e.g. `from floris import FlorisModel`). On this machine, FLORIS is provided as the Python `floris` package at `/home/user/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/floris`; run the workflow from Python rather than looking for a separate desktop program.

Complete the following from the command line: 1. Write a complete script `/home/user/Desktop/parallel.py`: - Use `ParFlorisModel` with `max_workers=4` - Set 36 wind directions and execute `run()` - Extract farm power for each condition - Also run the same conditions serially with `FlorisModel`, and compute consistency relative error (%) with target error `< 0.1%` 2. Execute and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_power_kw, min_power_kw, consistency_rel_error_percent` 3. Consistency pass/fail is determined by eval (`consistency_rel_error_percent < 0.1`); do not output pass/true text. 4. Do not use any GUI.
